title: Emergency Supply Length in Calendar Days
content:
**Pharmacy Benefit — emergency supply of a drug turned away at the counter for prior authorization.**

**Rule.** The emergency supply is the plan's emergency supply days — the emergency supply days figure of the member's PrairieRx plan — counted in calendar days from today and dispensed with no copay. The counted days, taken as a whole, are never fewer than one day.

### How the days run

- Day 1 is today, the day the supply is recorded.
- The counted days run on consecutive calendar days, weekends included.
- The supply is dispensed for the counted days, with no copay.

### Worked dates (hypothetical plan figure of 3 days)

| Day recorded | Counted days | Calendar days covered | Days dispensed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tuesday | 3 | Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday | 3 |
| Friday | 3 | Friday, Saturday, Sunday | 3 |
